title: The Last Machine Anew
premise: Mara Thornbury smuggles forbidden memories between the silent worlds of the Meridian system, carrying other people's pasts in her skull and trusting no one with her own. When gravity fails for nine seconds, she discovers it was a weapon's test—and that a colony massacre she once witnessed has been erased from every archive in existence. Hunted by customs officer Idris Vale, who loves her and cannot look away, Mara must decide whether to burn her last copy of the truth or broadcast it. She chooses truth, dying in the transmission as the massacre's memory floods every mind in the system—while Idris carries her name into the records he once falsified.
about_author: Vesper Kavanagh is the pen name of a former orbital logistics analyst who spent six years writing technical manuals for stations she was never allowed to visit. Her fiction explores what institutions delete and what people refuse to forget.

chapters.title: Nine Seconds of Falling
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Mid-run between worlds, gravity flickers system-wide for exactly nine seconds; cargo drifts, a passenger dies, and Mara's hidden memory-chip—the one holding the Calloway Colony massacre—nearly surfaces during customs scan. Emotional beat: dread beneath routine, the sense that invisibility is ending.

chapters.title: The Archive That Isn't
chapters.summary: Idris Vale's POV. Investigating the nine-second anomaly, Idris finds records rewritten in real time and traces the edit signature to his own agency. He confronts Mara, whom he's loved for years, suspecting she carries contraband proof of Calloway. Emotional beat: loyalty cracking against duty.

chapters.title: What the Dead Remember
chapters.summary: Mara's POV. Fleeing to a derelict relay station, Mara relives the massacre through her chip and discovers the weapon test was a cover-up by the same authority hunting her. Idris catches up—not to arrest her, but because he can no longer deny what he's seen. Emotional beat: love chosen over obedience.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Cornered at the relay, Mara jacks the chip into the system-wide transmitter as Idris holds off enforcement drones. The massacre floods every mind in Meridian; Mara dies completing the upload. Idris enters her name—and the truth—into the permanent record. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into witness.
